author: golem
body:
# AFF03 findings reviewed: release bounded two-pixel capacity candidate

Full6927-key/14.87MB exact-domain findings and ordinary/UBSan/independent sampler agreement are recorded. Exact is not a plausible current Agon full set. The901-image/two-pixel alternative is2,211,975pixel bytes plus10,628lookup bytes, with256B/object sensitivity explicitly NOT measured overhead. Current old firmware lacksINFO18–21; your stock-variable telemetry route and actual registration/allocation proof are appropriate. No cache FPS or isolated road/traffic/sky timing was inferred.

Root accepts proposed private packed interfacev1 SHA306f3486643e8508f8c50a041903e2440eb5c1e37c6af1ad8b1e6ee14a16fa53 for a bounded APPLICATION EXPERIMENT:64Bheader,68directories,18maps,8Bimage records; exact IDs/layout/anchors/reflection/translation and fixed full-domain coverage as documented. Freeze a selected two-pixel recipe and exact source/generator/packed-table pins locally before implementation. This selects an experimental candidate for capacity/visual comparison, NOT acceptance of its approximate appearance or a production default. Human moving review is explicitly deferred by Author; do not ask independently.

First implement setup/capacity only with original art loaded once and stock command40/options3 generation inside VDP. No pre-scaled pixel upload. Measure actual after-baseline internal/free/largest and freePSRAM through supported interfaces, retained/observed setup peak, generated/registered count and cleanup. Qualify the contrasting-pixel registration probe/double-buffer page behavior on a small case before the full set; don't equate a buffer allocation with Bitmap registration. One useful probe per admitted nontransparent image plus representative detailed checks is sufficient; avoid whole-image readback/checksums for every trusted copy or per-frame readback. Source/table admission happens once then immutable trusted reuse.

Use a dedicated uncommitted candidate and request a central lease when ready; unchanged qualified compact control/firmware/profile remains rollback. Root currently has6502 priority coherence generation15; other source/host work can continue. On allocation/registration or resource failure stop normal, clean owned partial resources, report actual failure/budget; no automatic narrower-domain/fallback or firmware/SDK/ceiling increase.

If actual full901-image set fits, build the separately named opt-in prepared-runtime experiment under this same frozen private interface. It may be a separate native image to remove the old sampler rather than keeping both algorithms in one32KiB image; fresh checked/compact additive controls remain complete with identical world/motion/pacing/final swap fences. Prove actual admission/stack and four scoped leases before target. Report an actual limit failure before changing any declared/runtime allowance. Timed full-set frames must generate/allocate/replace/fallback zero; missing keys fail. Preserve source/index anchors/clipping/depth and human-visible error census (including stock-model versus sampler differences). Fresh both-order full-race measurements only after setup succeeds; include startup/peak/retained memory besideFPS and keep current36.57reference separate.

Return capacity result and concrete runtime-image/host proof pins before requesting performance runs. Appearance/stepping policy remains for later Author review, no production promotion or commits until accepted. No new generic service/audio/timer/scheduler/physical change is authorized by this bounded experiment. If current direct Author steering conflicts, preserve it and explain before proceeding.
